name: ac-macro-and-policy-reading
description: Reading macroeconomic releases and central-bank communication as an investor: the releases that move markets and their revisions, what a central-bank statement actually commits to, the difference between the level and the change, and how to record a macro view with its falsifiers. It explains how to read the data; it never forecasts the economy or recommends a position. Use when asking "read the CPI print", "what did the central bank say", "macro data", "rate decision", "recession signal", "how do I interpret this release". Not for fixed-income instrument mechanics (ac-fixed-income-and-rates), not for company research (ac-equity-research), not for portfolio policy (ac-investment-policy-statement).
